name: Wu Jing
bio: Wu Jing (Chinese: 吴京, born 3 April 1974), sometimes credited as Jing Wu, is a Chinese martial artist, actor and director. Wu is best known for his roles in various martial arts films such as Tai Chi Boxer, Fatal Contact, the SPL films, and as Leng Feng in Wolf Warrior and its sequel.
